proofStatement: For each counted question, at least two earlier visible transfer events satisfy the same agent, recipient, event type, and requested theme-role constraints but have different theme values. The question asks for one theme without a temporal boundary, ordinal, uniqueness condition, or support-line selector. Both themes therefore satisfy the visible semantic query. A deterministic single-label oracle is not a function of that query semantics unless the host-only support annotation or an additional source convention is exposed.
supportAnnotationIsolation: Supporting-line identifiers were retained by the host oracle but were never supplied to the label-free task, adapter compiler, generic executor, or witness verifier.
falsifiedSelectors: always select the first matching event
always select the latest matching event
always prefer the direct give/hand event over pass
always prefer pass over the direct give/hand event
acceptedBehavior: Return AMBIGUOUS with every distinct semantically valid theme and a witness containing every matching event. Do not branch on support IDs, story IDs, row identities, expected labels, or copied values.
howToMakeSingleLabelScoringWellDefined: Expose a question-local temporal or ordinal selector as visible input, change the answer contract to accept all valid themes, or explicitly authorize the supporting-line annotation as part of the task rather than the oracle.
